system.description:
Once per Doom Quarter, roll a CR 1 Smarts Check. On a success, an ally of your choice is Steeled until the Combat Encounter ends; only one target can have it at a time. On a failure, the enemy closest to you is Steeled instead.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.48
system.summary: Once per Doom Quarter, roll a CR 1 Smarts Check. On a success, an ally of your choice is Steeled until the Combat Encounter ends; only one target can have it at a time. On a failure, the enemy closest to you is Steeled instead.

automation.onSuccess: The targeted ally is Steeled until the Combat Encounter ends.
automation.onFail: The enemy closest to you is Steeled until the Combat Encounter ends.

automation.note: Target the ally before rolling; on a success they are Steeled until combat ends. On a failure, target the enemy closest to you and click the 'Tonic failed' button. Only one creature can have the tonic at a time, so remove it from the previous one.
